question: With an average speed of 45 km/h, a train reaches its destination on time. If it goes with an average speed of 30 km/h, it is late by 15 minutes. The total journey is:
solution:
Given:

Actual speed = 45 km/h

Reduced speed = 30 km/h

Formula used:

Total distance = ((S₁ × S₂))/(S₁-S₂) times (T₁+T₂)
